description: A white lighthouse tower stands on an outcropping of land overlooking a calm body of water. In the background, a full moon shines brightly in a dark sky. A path leads from the bottom right of the image to the door of the lighthouse. Green trees surround the base of the lighthouse. In the bottom right corner of the work is text that reads "G.T.O.K."
title: Untitled (Lighthouse)
